categories.main_business_segments: TAIHO KOGYO operates two main business segments: (1) Automotive Parts, which includes bearings, bushings, system products, die-cast products, and gaskets; and (2) Automotive Manufacturing Equipment, which covers precision dies, transport equipment, welding machines, and related equipment for automotive production. The company also has a minor segment for welfare and facility management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies are based on tribology (friction, wear, lubrication), advanced materials engineering, and precision manufacturing. Key production methods include model-based development (MBD), CAE analysis, digital engineering for die-casting, and integrated production from materials to finished products. The company is also developing new materials and processes for next-generation bearings, electric vehicle components, and environmental solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TAIHO KOGYO primarily serves major automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, with Toyota Motor Corporation as its largest customer (accounting for 27.9% of sales). Its products are used in a wide range of vehicles, including internal combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicles, as well as in commercial vehicles and industrial applications. The company is expanding its customer base to global automakers in Europe, North America, China, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with manufacturing and sales operations in Japan, the United States, China, Indonesia, Thailand, Hungary, and South Korea. Sales are well-diversified, with significant revenue from Japan, the US, China, and other Asian countries. Production facilities and subsidiaries are strategically located to serve major automotive markets worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: TAIHO KOGYO operates primarily as a midstream supplier, manufacturing critical automotive components and systems that are supplied directly to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company also produces some upstream materials (e.g., bearing materials) and downstream finished products (e.g., gaskets, system modules), but its main role is as a component and module supplier within the automotive value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on strengthening its core automotive parts business while accelerating development in new domains such as electrification (battery components, power semiconductor cooling, fuel cell parts), and environmental solutions (e.g., water treatment systems). R&D priorities include next-generation bearings, high-value system products, advanced materials, and digital manufacturing. The company is also investing in DX (digital transformation), productivity improvement, and agile development structures.
categories.revenue_model: TAIHO KOGYO generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products (automotive parts and manufacturing equipment) to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. Revenue recognition is based on product delivery or project completion for equipment. The company also receives income from engineering services, technology licensing, and minor welfare/facility management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include global automotive component manufacturers specializing in bearings, bushings, die-cast parts, and gaskets, such as NTN, NSK, and Denso. TAIHO KOGYO is a leading supplier in its niche, with strong relationships with Toyota and other major automakers, and holds a significant global share in certain products (e.g., wheel balance weights, engine bearings). The company is positioned as a technology-driven, quality-focused supplier with global reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥112.8 billion, with an operating profit of ¥610 million and a net loss attributable to shareholders of ¥4.19 billion. The company employs approximately 4,090 people. While sales have shown modest growth (0.7% YoY), profitability declined due to restructuring costs, raw material price increases, and impairment losses. The company is in a phase of structural reform and investment for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TAIHO KOGYO differentiates itself through advanced tribology-based engineering, high reliability, and the ability to deliver integrated solutions from materials to finished components. The company emphasizes its expertise in friction-reducing, high-durability parts, rapid development cycles, and responsiveness to customer needs, especially for next-generation vehicles and environmental challenges. Its global supply capability and close partnerships with leading automakers further strengthen its value proposition.
